summary.text: Rebecca Martinez was first elected in November 2024 to represent the 22nd House District, which includes Plainville, Farmington and Southington.

paragraphs.text: She has worked in healthcare for over 24 years and, according to the page, is a nurse for Elara Caring.
Martinez served five years on the Plainville Board of Education and was appointed to the State Board of Examiners for Nursing in 2020, serving until December 2024.
She has lived in Plainville since 2009.
